title: Google adds a feature to let users with a Pixel 8 and newer connect their device to an external monitor via USB-C for a "desktop-like multi-window experience" (Emma Roth/The Verge)
summary: Emma Roth / The Verge: Google adds a feature to let users with a Pixel 8 and newer connect their device to an external monitor via USB-C for a “desktop-like multi-window experience” — The Pixel 8 and up will display a desktop-like experience when connected to an external monitor.
